data.body:
Refinement 2026-11-10 18:45 PST: which model runs depends on the gate path, not only on the workspace.
- Async MCP gate starters (review_plan_start, verify_completion_start) materialize an attested snapshot at current origin/main: both REVIEW_RESULTs recorded verified_at_sha 91182f96362 and ran_model bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5 (verifier), and CloudWatch shows us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 Invocations during those runs (18:20 PST bucket: 269). Those paths ARE on 5.5.
- The completion gate inside transition_ticket(closed) on itchy-neutral-whooper recorded verified_at_sha 3835269d792 (the stuck workspace HEAD) and model bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; CloudWatch shows sonnet-4-6 Invocations (3) in the same 18:25 PST bucket. So the close gate still runs on the stuck workspace's code and 4.x config, and signs a verdict against a 13-day-old tree.
So the impact is: every completion-gated close over production MCP verifies against 3835269d792 with 4.x models. The repair in the previous comment fixes both; whether the close path should resolve origin/main like the starters do is a separate question for this bug's root-cause criterion.
